source.rule: Copyrighted sources may remain external; expected SHA-256 must be retained.

evidence.rule: Execution alone never promotes evidence status.

comparison.rule: Reference population and evidence boundary must be explicit.

discrepancy.rule: Do not hide or tune unresolved discrepancies.

verification.rule: Computational verification is not engineering qualification.

ingestion.rule: Ingestion discovers candidates only; no candidate becomes engineering evidence without review and reproduction.

source_fingerprint.rule: Persist basename/hash/metadata only; never persist machine-specific absolute source paths.

target_candidates.rule: Lexical figure/table/equation discovery is a review queue, not evidence.

promotion_gate.rule: A study cannot enter the live registry while DRAFT/BLOCKED or without targets, results, tests and callable tools.

source_map.rule: Persist page-level hashes/counts and bounded target excerpts only; never persist full extracted source text by default.

target_dossiers.rule: Target dossiers are source-location aids. Automated excerpts/symbol/unit candidates require review before evidence promotion.

reproduction_tasks.rule: Generated tasks are plans, not completed reproduction or verification evidence.

structure_candidates.rule: Structure extraction is heuristic review material; extracted blocks/rows/captions do not become engineering evidence automatically.

comparison_templates.rule: Comparison templates specify candidate metrics only; metrics require source-backed reproduced/reference populations before evaluation.
